import re,os
lines=open('docs/CODE-LAYOUT.md').read().split('\n')
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    m=re.match(r'^\| `([a-z0-9\-]+\.js)` \| (.*)$', l)
    if not m: continue
    mod,desc=m.group(1),m.group(2)
    if re.search(r'Node-tested|node-tested|unit-tested|Unit-tested', desc):
        # find explicit test file mention
        named=re.findall(r'`([a-z0-9\-]+\.test\.js)`',desc)
        cand=['src/'+mod.replace('.js','.test.js')]+['src/'+n for n in named]+['public/js/'+n for n in named]
        if not any(os.path.exists(c) for c in cand):
            print('NO TEST FILE for',mod, named)
